semantic.justification: Ports the bounded slot, item-argument, completion, and return-item request contract while exposing browser payloads only at the adapter boundary. Iteration109 carries explicit unsigned UNO KeyModifier metadata separately from slot arguments to zero-default SfxRequest and document-owned paragraph StyleApply. Only native KEY_MOD1 triggers initial full-character/list reset. The existing content-manager owner constructs the registered native deletion set excluding list83..87; docfmt uses selective node reset with protected nonempty numbering/page/non-NONE break and Ctrl repeated-list eligibility. txtedt removes common automatic-style items while retaining unrelated items, exact flags and internet hints. Collection history owns hints before initial selective reset; the separate exact-reset owner captures after collection processing. Native redo retains list eligibility but omits the initial full-character flag and uses default non-exact hint reset, including repeated-style level asymmetry. Actual request/core/frame/mounted UI/ODT tests cover mask literals, filtering, ordinary/URL separation, protected defaults, inclusive empty/end-zero spans, untouched neighbors, partial/whole hints, history ownership, three cycles and continued input/export. Every prior test is byte-identical. Language/direction/fields/marks/layout/redlines/rings/inline headings, full UNO transforms/style families/native defaults/history and complete UI parity remain unverified; no status/default/exception promotion or registered save/open/recovery change. Older missing-modifier/deletion-set claims are superseded only for this bounded registered operation.
